name: Local AI Natureza Despesa - Session Mini-Memory & K-Medoids (CPU-Only)

parameters.query:
DELETE FROM slm_session_memory WHERE updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes';
SELECT
  '{{ ($json.body ? ($json.body.sessionId || "default-session") : ($json.sessionId || "default-session")).replace(/''/g, "''''") }}' AS "sessionId",
  '{{ ($json.body ? ($json.body.message || $json.body.chatInput || "") : ($json.chatInput || $json.message || "")).replace(/''/g, "''''") }}' AS "rawMessage",
  s.last_term AS "db_last_term",
  COALESCE(s.turn_count, 0) AS "db_turn_count",
  s.clusters_json AS "db_clusters"
FROM (SELECT 1) d
LEFT JOIN slm_session_memory s
  ON s.session_id = '{{ ($json.body ? ($json.body.sessionId || "default-session") : ($json.sessionId || "default-session")).replace(/''/g, "''''") }}';

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "qwen2.5-budget:1.5b", stream: false, options: { temperature: 0.0, num_ctx: 2048 }, prompt: $json.message }) }}

parameters.query:
SELECT
  nd.naturezadespesaformatada AS codigo,
  nd.descricaosubelemento AS descricao,
  sd.descricaosubelementodetalhe AS detalhe,
  sd.titulosubelementodetalhe AS titulo,
  '{{ $json.sessionId }}' AS "sessionId",
  '{{ $json.termo_busca }}' AS "termo_busca",
  CASE
    WHEN REPLACE(REPLACE(nd.naturezadespesaformatada, '.', ''), '-', '')
         = REPLACE(REPLACE('{{ $json.termo1 }}', '.', ''), '-', '') THEN 0
    WHEN REPLACE(REPLACE(nd.naturezadespesaformatada, '.', ''), '-', '')
         ILIKE REPLACE(REPLACE('{{ $json.termo1 }}', '.', ''), '-', '') || '%' THEN 1
    WHEN unaccent(nd.descricaosubelemento) ILIKE '%' || unaccent('{{ $json.termo1 }}') || '%' THEN 2
    WHEN unaccent(COALESCE(sd.descricaosubelementodetalhe, '')) ILIKE '%' || unaccent('{{ $json.termo1 }}') || '%' THEN 3
    WHEN unaccent(COALESCE(sd.titulosubelementodetalhe, '')) ILIKE '%' || unaccent('{{ $json.termo1 }}') || '%' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END AS prioridade
FROM naturezadespesa nd
LEFT JOIN subelementodetalhe sd
  ON REPLACE(REPLACE(sd.naturezadespesa, '.', ''), '-', '')
     = REPLACE(REPLACE(nd.naturezadespesaformatada, '.', ''), '-', '')
WHERE
  (
    unaccent(nd.descricaosubelemento || ' ' || COALESCE(sd.descricaosubelementodetalhe, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sd.titulosubelementodetalhe, ''))
      ILIKE '%' || LEFT(unaccent('{{ $json.termo1 }}'), GREATEST(LENGTH('{{ $json.termo1 }}') - 1, 4)) || '%'
    OR REPLACE(REPLACE(nd.naturezadespesaformatada, '.', ''), '-', '')
      ILIKE '%' || REPLACE(REPLACE('{{ $json.termo1 }}', '.', ''), '-', '') || '%'
  )
  AND (
    unaccent(nd.descricaosubelemento || ' ' || COALESCE(sd.descricaosubelementodetalhe, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(sd.titulosubelementodetalhe, ''))
      ILIKE '%' || LEFT(unaccent('{{ $json.termo2 }}'), GREATEST(LENGTH('{{ $json.termo2 }}') - 1, 4)) || '%'
    OR REPLACE(REPLACE(nd.naturezadespesaformatada, '.', ''), '-', '')
      ILIKE '%' || REPLACE(REPLACE('{{ $json.termo2 }}', '.', ''), '-', '') || '%'
  )
ORDER BY prioridade, codigo, detalhe
LIMIT 60;

INSERT INTO slm_session_memory (session_id, last_term, turn_count, clusters_json, updated_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ String($json.sessionId || "default-session").replace(/''/g, "''''") }}',
  NULLIF('{{ String($json.save_last_term || "").replace(/''/g, "''''") }}', ''),
  {{ Number($json.save_turn_count || 0) }},
  '{{ String($json.save_clusters_json || "null").replace(/''/g, "''''") }}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET
  last_term = EXCLUDED.last_term,
  turn_count = EXCLUDED.turn_count,
  clusters_json = EXCLUDED.clusters_json,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING
  session_id AS "sessionId",
  '{{ String($json.acao_memoria || $json.acao || "concluido").replace(/''/g, "''''") }}' AS "acao",
  '{{ String($json.output || "").replace(/''/g, "''''") }}' AS "output";
